reserveReview.rationale: The 100% slice describes the authenticated whole fund-share claim, following BUIDL single-fund-share presentation. It does not invent underlying Treasury, repo, deposit or credit weights. Native tokenized participating shares in a Singapore VCC money-market sub-fund managed by UBS Asset Management (Singapore). The distributor names State Street Bank and Trust as custodian/administrator and high-quality money-market instruments; exact underlying strategy, private placement memorandum and current position weights are not publicly disclosed.
